Connection: Inspect attached ADBC databases, list connection profiles, and refresh attached catalog metadata. Connect with ATTACH … (TYPE adbc) and disconnect with DETACH.
Query: Read arbitrary SQL results with adbc_scan or named tables with adbc_scan_table.
Mutation: Execute remote DDL/DML with CALL adbc_execute, or ingest Arrow batches with adbc_insert. Both join an open BEGIN … COMMIT transaction.
Schema: Inspect tables, columns, table types, and named-table Arrow schemas through driver metadata APIs.
